q: How do I calculate a fulfilment centre's emissions per parcel?
title: Fulfilment centre emissions per parcel
short: Add the centre's electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, diesel for backup and forklifts, and refrigerant top ups, then divide by parcels shipped. Packaging and inbound and outbound trucking are separate Scope 3 lines. A 3PL sharing a site allocates by area or volume.

ul: Diesel invoices for generators and forklifts.
Parcels dispatched from the warehouse system.

p: If one building serves several clients, split by floor area, pallet positions or parcels, and state which.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
